response.sql: SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_sum, AVG(invoice_count * 1.0) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM (SELECT c.State AS State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice i JOIN Customer c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) AS t
